notes.title: Hotfix: Mirror Varren Fight
notes.notes:
Today's hotfix is to fix a bug that was introduced with our last update causing the mirror version of Varren to not be killable outside of the Emperor's Palace in the Prefecture portion of the game.

Apologies to those of you who experienced this issue, we hope you're able to continue the rest of the game now!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Major Fixes and Polishing Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Fixes and Polishing[/h1]

This patch addresses some game breaking bugs and also tries to improve many various parts of the game. Key highlights include fixing a game breaking issue where the lever in the Ducky boss fight couldn't be interacted with, and polishing/updating the Cousin Varren boss fight as we know that's probably the most troublesome boss of the game. You can see the full changelog below:

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the lever in the Ducky boss fight couldn't be interacted with.
[*] Cousin Varren landing in the center of the fight area and getting stuck there out of the players reach has been fixed.
[*] Fixed area in Twisted Sewers where the player could get out of the map.
[*] Extra measure for preventing the instant death while grinding across the long rail in the Twisted Sewers. We've done fixes in the past but it seems the issue is very hit or miss, hopefully it will never be experienced again.
[*] Fixed collider issues in the Prefecture Surface on day 6.
[*] Fixed a couple cutscenes that weren't immediately loading a next level and had black screen delays.
[*] Fixed a cutscene text issue in the Thomas Vorrington area.
[*] Weapon lighting fixed in Mirrored 3rd Floor.
[/list]

[h3]Polishing and Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] Courtyard Dandy boss fight water animated and splash sound effects added when walking in it.
[*] DOF effect added to camera in Courtyard Dandy boss fight.
[*] Added health herb consumable to Courtyard Dandy boss fight.
[*] Added falling ash variations to majority of levels and cutscenes.
[*] Twisted 1st Floor arrival scene polished.
[*] Twisted 4th Floor animated section of water that was static.
[*] Updated asphalt textures outside of Ducky's Playhouse.
[*] Updated Ducky's Playhouse childrens note.
[*] Updated placement of text in Ducky cutscenes.
[*] Pre-fight music added to Ducky boss fight.
[*] Ducky boss fight animations polish.
[*] Added sledgehammer weapon to Mirrored 3rd Floor.
[*] General polishing Mirrored 3rd Floor.
[*] Mirrored 5th floor window require axe to break.
[*] Environment hints in Cathedral.
[*] Animated Basement water that wasn't already.
[*] Water splash sound effects for Basement and Sewer.
[*] Cousin Varren boss fight ladder now extended to be more apparent without boxes to climb to reach it.
[*] Cousin Varren now has a shield indicating when he can't be damaged. He also no longer blocks axe attacks when the shield is active. We know this was making players think that the axe would damage him.
[*] Cousin Varren modified button push cutscene and other polish.
[*] Polished and added falling debris to the returning from Die-Sin cutscene.
[*] Added a no-camera sign near fallen debris in the Twisted Sewer to help indicate the camera is needed.
[/list]

We hope this fixes the issues some players have had and that everyone enjoys the polish changes!

[i]~ Tyler & Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #15
notes.notes:
Today's patch includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*] The 10th extra not unlocking has been fixed. If you've already beaten the game it should be unlocked now.
[*] Fixed missing collisions on obstacles in the slaughter house boss area.
[*] Fixed Michael vanishing into/under a table during part of one of the final boss cutscenes.
[/list]

Thanks all for the continued support and we hope you all continue to enjoy the game!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #14
notes.notes:
Today's patch includes an important fix for incorrect health values after loading saves along with some other improvements. Full changelog below:

[list]
[*] Issue where health value was incorrect sometimes after loading saves (especially from the death screen) should now be fixed.
[*] The Kawashi boss fight in the 2nd level of the Prefecture now has music and ambient lighting matching the boss intro and transformation cutscenes.
[*] A new save point has been added to the Vorington Pantheon to allow saving right before the Thomas Vorington boss fight.
[*] Some collision improvements to the second floor of the Cousin Varren boss fight to prevent being able to clip the camera into the wall.
[*] Some additional collision improvements in the interior of the Emperor's Palace where the player could walk through a few objects.
[/list]

Thank you everyone who has been continuing to report these issues. Also a big thanks to those of you who have left reviews recently, they really help us out!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #13
notes.notes:
Todays patch includes one important fix to the hotel exterior enemies along with another minor change to the main menu:

[list]
[*] The first enemies after getting the axe will now stay downed in their 'seizing' state for a prolonged amount of time to encourage the player to continue past them. They were immediately getting back up to attack the player which was not intended but a side effect of changes we made to our 'base enemy' that all individual enemies inherit behavior from.
[*] We have modified the credits when accessed from the main menu to play faster. The end game credits were not affected by this change.
[/list]

As always thanks for the continued support! We'd love to see more screenshots, videos, artwork, guides, and reviews in the community if any of you amazing players feel so inclined to share any of the above!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #12
notes.notes:
Todays patch includes the following changes and fixes:

[list]
[*] Added credits button to the main menu options page as a shortcut to see who all came together to make the game without having to beat the game first.
[*] Fixed Michael voice line repeating when loading in the Cathedral after talking to the balloon.
[*] After defeating the day 3 Prefecture boss enemies are disabled now upon returning to talk to Hope before returning to the surface.
[*] It should no longer possible to get into the tank before the day 3 Prefecture boss introduction cutscene.
[*] Fixed the final day 3 Hope conversation after the boss fight having old character portraits.
[*] Being able to cancel/short the cutscene after fulfilling the first shrine requirements on day 5 of the Prefecture by running through the collision trigger too quickly should no longer be possible. This would result in a soft lock.
[*] Being able to do the same with a cutscene on day 4 of the Prefecture should also no longer be possible.
[*] Lastly, the very odd issue where some players were dying mid-slide across the long rail in the Twisted Sewers should finally be stamped out. This was an issue that always appeared to semi-randomly get introduced during the build stage and we thought was already fixed until another player experienced the issue. We now explicitly have made it so that our death collision colliders (used for if the player falls off of a rail) will not work if the player is actively sliding on a rail. Again this issue should finally be truly taken care of!
[/list]

As always thanks for the continued support! We'd love to see more screenshots, videos, artwork, guides, and reviews in the community if any of you amazing players feel so inclined to share any of the above!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #11
notes.notes:
Todays patch includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Twisted Ducky puzzle progress should now be saved once you have successfully raised the giant Ducky's head and/or opened his mouth.
[*] The button overlap issue that could occur with certain resolutions when using computers in the Twisted 4th Floor should be fixed.
[*] Fixed wall gap that was found in the slaughter house in the 5th level of the Prefecture.
[/list]

Thanks all for the continued support! Please continue to let us know how you're enjoying the game so far!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #10
notes.notes:
The following fixes have been made since patch notes #9 came out. Some have been fixed already for a few days but most are from todays updates:

[list]
[*] Fixed Prefecture level 3 sequence. Hope and Autumn cutscene that was playing early now occurs only after defeating the level 3 boss and then returning back to the starting area. Before the level was ending prematurely directly after beating the boss.
[*] Added a save point to the third Prefecture level.
[*] Prefecture level 2 boss Varren should no longer be able to attack while transitioning to his floating state.
[*] When returning to the Grand Wizard's Sanctum (Chapter 3) after defeating Thomas Vorrington the teleporter should now be disabled and the imprisoned gods shouldn't be reset.
[*] Fixed "Are you okay" voice line replaying upon leaving the slaughter house in Prefecture level 5.
[*] Fixed double "Do we need to do anything" voice line in Prefecture level 5.
[*] Fixed "Find our 4 cores" voice line replaying upon returning to the Twisted 4th Floor.
[*] Disabled non-hooked up toy vending machine in the tram area of Prefecture level 2. (More on this in the future)
[/list]

We should have another patch ready soon which will include the following fixes:
[list]
[*] Ensuring the Twisted 4th Floor computers overlapping button issue is fixed by removing their dependence on resolution. We thought we had addressed this before but it appears we need a more concrete fix.
[*] Fix for Twisted Ducky's puzzle progress not being saved.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for helping us out and continuing to report issues when you find them. We've also really enjoyed reading recent reviews and other feedback. As always we hope everyone continues to enjoy the game!

[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #9
notes.notes:
The following fixes have been included in today's update:

[list]
[*] Fixed Hope and targets reappearing upon re-entering or loading the 1st ward area on day 1 of the Prefecture.
[*] Fixed repeated Horizon voice line when using shrine in slaughter house on day 5 of the Prefecture.
[*] Fixed being able to see player arms during Horizon departs cutscene (Twisted 4th Floor).
[*] Removed static sound from tipped over wheel chair in Twisted 1st Floor.
[*] Fixed player having to use interaction button to be able to move after the Kara cutscene upon emerging from the Twisted Sewers.

We hope everyone is enjoying the game! More fixes on the way and we'll be announcing a small content update towards the end of the month well!
[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #8 (Hotfix)
notes.notes:
Quick hotfix to address the issue where loading a save after dying can spawn the player with zero health. Additional fixes / full list below:

[list]
[*] Loading a save after dying should no longer have a chance to spawn the player with zero health.
[*] Fixed Prefecture 4th level repeated voice lines during Abalon dialog.
[*] Fixed/removed ledge requiring jumping to get to button on side of furnaces in Twisted Ducky's level.
[*] Made plunger easier to interact with on Edison 4th floor.
[/list]

We are working on more of the known issues currently and should have another patch out soon! Thanks as always for your patience and we hope that you all continue to enjoy the game!
[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes #7 (Major Optional Change to Health)
notes.notes:
Along with a few fixes this patch includes a major optional change to increase difficulty and the need for consumable items. Full list below:

[list]
[*] MAJOR: Health now persists when new areas/levels start as well as when loading saved games. This change is active by default, BUT there is now a 'Health Resets' option in the options menu for opting out of this change. If 'Health Resets' is turned on your health will be refilled upon changing areas and loading saves.
[*] Charge shot now takes slightly more stamina but does double the normal lament arms damage to make a noticeable difference (before was set to be 1.5 times damage)
[*] Fixed controller bug where blocking with the axe could stop working after attacking.
[*] Fixed dialog and subtitles not being enabled for roller coaster cutscene in Twisted Ducky area.
[*] Fixed sewer path not being enabled after returning to the sewers or loading a save after pushing the button to raise the path.
[*] Fixed wood plank breaking sound effects and white light flash occurring when loading Twisted Sewers saves after having broken wood plank barriers.
[*] Slightly boosted the health gained from chocolate bar on first floor of the Edison, and made the pickup hitbox a little larger.
[/list]

Please let us know if you encounter further issues and we'd love to hear what you all think of the change to health persisting!
[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

[list]
[*] Lots of fixes to the second chapter around voice lines and caption syncing.
[*] Fixed a few notes that couldn't be interacted with in later levels.
[*] Some minor environment texture updates primarily in the second and third chapters.
[*] A couple of character illustrations have been improved in the second chapter.
[*] Fixed bug where NPC names would overlap on some days in the Prefecture hub.

[*] Fixed graphics quality setting not persisting across levels/play sessions.

notes.title: Patch Notes #5 (Major Fixes)
notes.notes:
Two major issues that we've been trying to figure out have now been fixed alongside additional smaller fixes and additions. The first primary fix is the camera tilt that some players have experienced causing the camera to be tilted along with potentially messing with movement directions. It took a while to replicate and come up with a solution but it appears to no longer be possible to replicate when we test the fix on our end. The second main fix is for the scattered directional audio problems throughout the game. We have updated our game manager to find all audio sources with inversed audio and correct it when levels are loaded. Please report to us if you still encounter either of these issues or any new issues.

The following is a list of most fixes and changes that have been made since patch notes #4. 

[list]
[*] Directional audio problems should largely be fixed across the game if not entirely.
[*] Camera tilt bug should be fixed and not possible to replicate since most recent update.
[*] Added a reset switch for the paintings puzzle in the twisted 4th floor.
[*] Fixed dialogue not being enabled in Ducky sub boss cutscenes.
[*] A number of adjustments and fixes in the second chapter areas.
[*] Fixed more interactions that were causing weapons to become frozen until pausing or interacting with an additional interaction.
[*] Updated first floor vending machines to not ask for a quarter as they are just part of the environment.
[*] Updated mirror enemies to be easier to hit.
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support and we hope you continue to enjoy the game!
[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

[*] Fixed bug where player could become frozen after Michael's home cutscene in path to reactor core (Prefecture 2nd level).
[*] Fixed dialogue not being present for cutscene after defeating Varren boss.

Thank you all!
[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

[*] Directional audio for ringing phone should be correct now.

Thanks and we hope everyone continues to enjoy the game!
[i]~ Tyler and Jon[/i]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
We have decided to delay release by one month to July 28th to not compete with the Summer sale for visibility reasons and a couple other circumstances out of our immediate control such as one of our two primary developers being out sick for a short time. We're both currently cranking out the final touches now along with doing our best to test the game with our handful of awesome testers.

We appreciate the continued support and are so excited to get CONCLUSE 2 into your hands next month! And if you have the time and desire we could still use testers, please see our previous announcement for details!

notes.title: Release Date & Testers Wanted!
notes.notes:
[h2]Release Date - June 30th[/h2]
CONCLUSE 2’s development cycle has been a long one but we’re finally ready to announce a final release date! The final release date for CONCLUSE 2 is Friday, June 30th! That date is also the 5-year anniversary of the original CONCLUSE's release! We have learned so much over the last 5 years of development, and we can’t wait to show gamers and horror fans the final product. Please stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to CONCLUSE 2’s release.

[h2]Some Stats[/h2] 
Let us re-iterate some stats of what the game has evolved into.
[list]
[*] 3 distinct sections of the game which a player can start from after having reached them the first time.
[*] Approximately 2 hours of in-game cutscenes.
[*] 60+ unique enemies spread throughout the game.
[*] 10+ unique boss fights.
[*] 40+ music tracks, enough to be broken into 3 soundtracks.
[*] Roster of 15 talented voice actors.
[/list]
Other new features and improvements upon the first Concluse include:
[list]
[*] An array of consumable items to aid combat and exploration.
[*] Improved controls.
[*] Objectives to help direct the player.
[*] Optional interaction indicators.
[*] Graphics quality and brightness options.
[/list]

[h2]Looking for testers![/h2]
We have a very small handful of testers currently and now that they have made their way through the majority of the game we are looking to add some new players to the roster! Based off of current playtesting we currently estimate an average playtime of at least [b]20 hours[/b]. If you are interested in getting your hands on the game early, and will have the time to play through the game over the next few weeks you can DM [i]TAllenDev#2940[/i] on Discord.

notes.title: Release Delayed
notes.notes:
Unfortunately we have decided that it is necessary for us to postpone release until summer of this year. It was not an easy decision for us but we felt that it was necessary as we continue to polish and add final features into the game. We hope that you all understand and will look forward to some exciting new preview content that will be coming soon.

In the meantime please enjoy this content from [url=https://twitter.com/Snowspot]@Snowspot[/url]'s more recent tweets!
